caption: Wool and synthetic blankets cover glacier ice at Glacier 3000, with snowy peaks beyond.
Oslo, Norway The Norwegian prime minister, Jonas Gahr Støre, bows to King Harald V’s coffin during his funeral ceremony at Oslo Cathedral.

Devighat, Nepal People hold on to a cage on a makeshift zipline as they cross the Trishuli River after deadly flash floods and a mudslide that damaged bridges and stranded residents in Nuwakot district.

Marawi, Philippines Army personnel check a vehicle as they guard a Commission on Election checkpoint along a highway in Lanao Del Sur province, on the southern island of Mindanao, before elections in the Bangsamoro autonomous region next week.
Berlin, Germany Alice Weidel, the AfD co-leader, speaks during the 2027 budget debate in the Bundestag.

London, UK Passengers at Heathrow during disruption after a system issue hit Nats, which provides air traffic control services to 15 UK airports. Cancellations and delays are expected as airlines deal with the knock-on effects of flights which were cancelled to and from UK airports on Tuesday.
Paris, France A Vortex reusable spacecraft developed by Dassault Aviation at the International Space Summit.
Changsha, China Women pose for a picture next to a monument of a young Mao Zedong in Hunan province on the 50th anniversary of the death of the late Chinese communist leader.
Beijing, China Models on a catwalk show designs by Liu Wei, on the theme of green tech uniform, during China fashion week.

Hormozgan, Iran An oil tanker waits off the coast of Bandar Abbas in the strait of Hormuz. Tankers, anchored about 10 miles offshore, are reported to be waiting due to the threat of a US attack, and serious deformation, including rust, which was observed on the surface of vessels that have remained stationary for an extended period.
Sha’ar Binyamin, West Bank An Israeli soldier stands at a winery in the Israeli settlement of Sha’ar Binyamin in the occupied West Bank, south-east of Ramallah.

Kyiv, Ukraine Rescuers work at the site of a strike on a high-storey residential building. At least four people were injured as a result of an overnight Russian attack, according to the Ukrainian state emergency service.

New York City The Tribute in Light is illuminated over the skyline of lower Manhattan and One World Trade Center, as seen from the Empire State Building, ahead of the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attack.
Two women with their back to the camera look at a wall covered in photographs of missing people.
Kyiv, Ukraine A woman and her child walk past the site of a Russian missile strike.
São Paulo, Brazil Supporters of the presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro take part in an Independence Day rally.
Nuwakot, Nepal A man sits on the balcony of his home damaged in the country’s flash-flood disaster.
Kathmandu, Nepal Women look at a wall covered with photographs of people reported missing after the country’s flash-flood disaster.
Kfar Rumman, Lebanon Relatives of those killed in an Israeli airstrike mourn during their funeral procession.
Aqraba, West Bank A view of a new illegal Israeli outpost being built on Palestinian land south of Nablus.
Beijing, China A vendor holds a poster of Mao Zedong on the eve of the 50th anniversary of his death.
Entre Rios, Argentina People pay homage to the late cumbia singer Gilda at a sanctuary dedicated to her on the 30th anniversary of her death.
Peshawar, Pakistan A teacher gives a girls’ reading class on International Literacy Day.
Port-au-Prince, Haiti Two boys in school uniform have their shoes shined in the street on the first day of the new academic year.
Glasgow, Scotland Ballet dancers pose to promote their contemporary double bill Emergence at the Theatre Royal.
Havana, Cuba A woman arranges a figurine of the Virgin of Regla, or Yemaya in the Yoruba religion, on her feast day.
Madrid, Spain A model backstage waits to present a creation by the designer Angel Schlesser at the Omoda Madrid es Moda fashion show.
Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Elton John performs at the Cidade do Rock festival.
Spata, Greece The mother of three newborn Sumatran tiger cubs walks in her enclosure at the Attica zoological park.
London, England Members of the King’s Troop Royal Horse Artillery prepare to give a 41-gun salute to mark the fourth anniversary of King Charles III’s accession to the throne.
Residents commute across the Trishuli river on a newly installed zip wire in the aftermath of flash floods in Devighat.

Brasília, Brazil The Brazilian president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, attends an Independence Day parade. The rightwing presidential hopeful Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is seeking to capitalise on a crisis engulfing the country’s supreme court, where two justices accuse each other of wrongdoing.

Coventry, UK The chancellor, John Healey, delivers a speech at the Manufacturing Technology Centre. In his first big address since taking up the job in July, Healey said boosting economic growth would be his priority and warned that Labour must be honest on spending.

Nuuk, Greenland Denmark’s prime minister, Mette Frederiksen, joins the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen, and Greenland’s head of government, Jens-Frederik Nielsen, on a visit to Eutelsat OneWeb, a company that provides broadband satellite internet services.

Portsmouth, UK A local resident collects some of the discarded life jackets near Eastney beach after unrest following the arrival of a boat carrying asylum seekers. Ministers condemned the ‘thuggish and intimidating behaviour’ of far-right activists who blocked roads in the city.

London, UK A journalist looks at a section of the Bayeux tapestry during a press preview at the British Museum. The 70-metre embroidery has returned to Britain for the first time in almost 1,000 years, on loan as part of an agreement between the UK and France.

Venice, Italy Pamela Anderson poses at the Hotel Excelsior Lido pier during the city’s film festival. Her latest movie, Place to Be, is been screening out of competition. She was honoured at a gala on Sunday evening for her work in the fight against Aids.

Prague, Czechia A gardener cuts a cluster of grapes in the south gardens of Prague Castle. More than 500kg of grapes are expected to be harvested from its 262 Hibernal vines to produce wine for the castle’s official needs. The harvest began two weeks earlier than usual because of a very hot summer.

Belgrade, Serbia People gather around the grave of the former Bosnian Serb army commander and war criminal Ratko Mladić at the Topcider cemetery. Mladić, 84, died last week while serving a life sentence for genocide and other crimes against humanity carried out during the Bosnian war.

Zaporizhzhia, Ukraine Rescuers work at the site of a Russian drone strike on a shopping centre. The City Center mall has been closed since the beginning of September because of persistent Russian attacks on civilian infrastructure. No casualties were reported after the strike.

Kathmandu, Nepal Children attend a gathering to observe a national day of mourning for victims of flash floods and mudslides triggered by a glacier collapse. At least 1,342 people were killed in Nepal, with a further 5,000 remaining missing across the region.

Bandar Abbas, Iran A boy stands with his bicycle on a beach overlooking commercial vessels anchored in the strait of Hormuz. On Sunday, the former US defence secretary Leon Panetta said the Iran conflict was likely to drag on for another six months and risked becoming another ‘forever war in the Middle East’.
New York, US Revellers take part in the J’ouvert celebration during the annual West Indian Day parade in Brooklyn.
